comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: Now available in the Premium Sailors bottle. This works pretty much like the Bell of Withdrawal but has a significantly higher (100%?) chance of retreating from melee battle successfully.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
In addition to being able to win them through Sailors bottle, These can also be made with an aide production recipe. Aide must have R15 Handicrafts and it will need 10 Gunpowder, 30 Steel, and 10 Smoke Ball. Production makes 1.

In turn, Smoke balls is also only made with an aide production recipe. Aide must have R10 Handicrafts. That one requires 200 Saltpetre, 200 Sugar, and 5 Mortar. Production makes 4.

So you can see, it's quite a bit of work just to make a small batch...

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: 5x of this was in the treasure chest "Instructor Researcher Award" received by reporting Ancient Technology Research from Atlantis.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body: I'd estimate under 5m, as that's what they typically went for on GAMA and they're obtainable a couple of different ways.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
These are also available at the Maritime guild shop.

Also they're less than 100% chance of escape, although they seem particularly effective against NPCs. I once heard its more like 45% chance of escape, although that could be entirely false, and could be that it has differing success rates for NPCs and players, and that the % success varies based on other factors (NPC level, # crew, any skills like obstruction/refined melee, etc.). I do know that this can definitely fail, though. Anyone with more accurate info feel free to chime in.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
*sneezes*...

Why do I have to see this item back brrr. Anyway, this one is an enhanced version of Bell of Withdrawal that nearly garantuee (approx. 95 %) you to escape from melee battle. The reason that they made this in less quantity in UWO is the fact it could break the melee battle AND deckbattle system.

The only way to counter them is through "obstruction" skill of your Aide(s) AND/OR having refined Assault or Gunfire skill in use.

I hope this gives an clear answer. ^^

Kind Regards,

Huseyin_Gazi
